snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Arbites Class Announcement
snippet.description:
You are justice. 

The Adeptus Arbites are  Warhammer 40,000: Darktide's first new class! They enforce the Lex Imperialis – the Imperial Law.  Utterly unforgiving, they persecute heretics and traitors throughout the Emperor’s realm. As an Arbitrator, you are a warrior of the Emperor’s justice, prosecuting crimes against the Imperium with disciplined zeal. Restore order to Tertium with your Cyber-Mastiff and a devastating array of new weaponry.
